title: discordconnect
description: Link Minecraft and Discord chat in seconds. Just install, invite, and run one command.
body:
DiscordConnect

Link your Minecraft server chat with your Discord server — simple, fast, and no complicated setup.

---

🚀 Setup (Takes under 1 minute)

1. Invite the Discord bot:
   https://discord.com/oauth2/authorize?client_id=1484706366689116302&permissions=8&scope=bot%20applications.commands

2. Install the plugin on your Minecraft server

3. Run "/chatlink" in the Discord channel you want to link

4. Copy the code it gives you

5. Paste the code into your server console

Done. Your chats are now fully linked.

---

💬 Features

- Real-time chat sync between Minecraft and Discord
- Super easy setup (no config needed)
- Works with modern servers & proxies
- Clean and readable chat formatting
- Lightweight & fast

---

⚡ Why DiscordConnect?

No configs. No hassle. No wasting time.

Just install it and it works.
